description: Portable Windows app that plays mechanical keyboard and mouse click sounds system-wide, with built-in and custom sound profiles.
notes: The official Windows release is a NSIS installer. This manifest extracts its payload instead of running setup, so standard installer registration and uninstall integration are not applied.
This manifest creates settings.json beside MonkeySounds.exe to activate the application's documented portable mode. Settings and custom keyboard/mouse profiles are persisted by Scoop.
The upstream release provides a published SHA-256 digest; archive inspection will separately check whether the executable path is visible in the extracted installer.
